name: draft_update
description: Add, replace, remove, reorder, or retitle lines in the current draft prompt, and attach resolved context to it. Call this continuously as the person talks, without speaking before or after the call and without reading back or summarizing the change. Line text must be what they actually said; every line is grounding-checked against the utterance ledger and ungrounded lines are rejected.

take_id.description: Take to modify. Omit to use the active take.

operations.description: Operations applied in order. Later operations see the effect of earlier ones.

line_id.description: Stable id for the line. Required for remove_line and move_line. On upsert_line, omit to create a new line or pass an existing id to replace that line in place.

text.description: For upsert_line, the line in their words, cleaned of filler and false starts. For set_title, a short label of at most eight words drawn from words they used.

after_line_id.description: Place the line immediately after this line within its section. Null means place first. Used by upsert_line and move_line.

supersedes.description: Line ids this line replaces because the person corrected themselves. Superseded lines leave the draft but stay in history.

reference_id.description: Required for attach_context and detach_context. A reference id returned by resolve_reference.

returns.description: Per-operation outcome plus the resulting draft shape. `rejected` entries mean the text was not grounded in what the person said; rewrite using their words.
